conviction_note: Mild long lean (p_up 54) on a documented habit of guiding low and beating its own quarterly guide (Q4 FY26 by about 5% on revenue and 6.6% on EBITDA) and a 12.6% pre-event drawdown from the high. The +15 put skew and an Investor Day the next morning (7 Oct, 09:00 ET, inside the window) set the size and could go either way, so p_up stays near 50 and abs_move is set at 13, above the 10.8 event-implied move, because of the investor day and the name's 16.5% median reaction. impact_sum (+2.0) is larger than the scaled +1.04 because the findings are sized one at a time and the sign uncertainty from the investor day goes into p_up and not into the findings.

EBITDA ~$37m (Q4 FY26 release, 2026-07-30, https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_news/Neogen-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf). positioning_check: Short interest 11,168,684 shares = 5.1% of float, 4.53 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-15, up 586,499 from the prior period (https://equibles.com/stocks/neog/shortinterest). The next FINRA release is 2026-10-09, after the window. Older aggregator figures of 9.85% or 12.66% were not settlement-dated and are set aside. Not a crowded short. Baseline skew: +15.31 vol points of 25-delta put over call ('downside paid'), put/call OI 0.66, ATM IV 91%, event-implied move 10.77%, 10-day straddle 12.89% (the 16 Oct expiry also covers Investor Day). Spot $12.22 is -12.6% from the 52-week high (~$13.98) and -4.0% over 5 days. MarketBeat 2026-09-29 put the selling down to caution ahead of the 6 Oct release and 7 Oct Investor Day, with no company headline (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-neogen-nasdaq-neog-shares-down-45-should-you-sell-2026-09-29/). Institutions hold ~97%. Ratings: 3 Buy / 1 Hold / 1 Sell; Piper Sandler upgraded to Overweight with a $14 target on 2026-08-26.

findings.finding: Neogen has guided below what it delivers. The April FY26 guide ($857-860m revenue, ~$175m adj. EBITDA, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711377/000119312526148851/neog-ex99_1.htm) less nine-month actuals ($645.1m revenue, $132.4m EBITDA) implied Q4 of ~$212-215m and ~$42.6m. Q4 came in at $225.3m and $45.4m, about 5% above on revenue and 6.6% above on EBITDA. The CFO said on 2026-07-30 that 'our guidance reflects our philosophy of setting targets as we focus on restoring investor credibility'. The Q1 FY27 guide is $207-209m / ~$37m and consensus ($208.1m, EPS $0.04) sits at its midpoint, so the same pattern repeated would print ~$213-218m revenue and EBITDA near $39-40m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has paid for beats. 2026-07-30: beat ($0.09 vs $0.05-0.06, revenue $225.3m vs $212.35m) plus an above-consensus first FY27 guide, +22.66%. 2026-01-08: +31.57%. 2025-10-09: +16.49%. The misses were 2025-04-09 (-28.69%) and 2025-07-29 (-10.89%). The two biggest rallies came with guidance news, and Q1 is a pre-guided quarter, so this beat alone is sized well below them.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus revenue ($208.1m) sits at the midpoint of the guide, not at the guide plus the 5% Q4 pattern. The whisper ($0.06 vs $0.04) prices part of a beat. If the market fully expected a beat of Q4's size, the stock would not have given back 12.6% from its high into the print with a +15 put skew.
findings.independence: The guide-versus-actual arithmetic rests on two company documents: the April 8-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711377/000119312526148851/neog-ex99_1.htm) and the July release (https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_news/Neogen-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf). The EPS whisper above consensus (https://earningswhispers.com/article/NEOG/20293) points the same way.

findings.finding: Neogen hosts an Investor Day in New York on Wednesday 2026-10-07 at 9 a.m. ET, announced 2026-09-08. That is the morning after this amc release and inside the exit window. It explains the first-ever switch from bmo to amc, and no officer change was filed (the only 8-K since July is a director resignation). The call already stated a long-term ~30% adj. EBITDA margin objective (FY27 guide 20.5%) and R&D rising toward ~5% of revenue from ~2% (+50% in FY27), with revenue payback 'starting in fiscal year 29'. Multi-year targets on the 7th will reprice the stock in either direction on top of the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior Neogen investor day under this management. Guidance has been the line that moved this stock: +22.66% on the above-consensus FY27 guide (2026-07-30) and -28.69% on the 2025-04-09 cut.
findings.why_not_priced: The date is public, so this changes how big the move is, not which way. The 16 Oct straddle (12.89%) covers both events, while the event-implied 10.77% is measured against a single print. The baseline's history of seven bmo prints never had an investor day stacked the morning after.
findings.independence: The amc switch is confirmed by the company release of 2026-09-15 (https://finviz.com/news/392418/neogen-announces-first-quarter-earnings-release-date). The long-term targets come from the Q4 transcript, the same document as finding 1, but a different line.

findings.finding: The $160m Genomics sale to Zoetis ($140m net, earmarked for debt paydown and net leverage under 3x by the end of calendar 2026) needs Australian and New Zealand approval. The ACCC moved it to an in-depth Phase 2 in July (up to 90 business days). NZ's Commerce Commission issued a Statement of Issues on 2026-07-27 saying Zoetis and Neogen are 'the two main providers of genomic testing for beef cattle', with a decision scheduled for 2026-09-15. No clearance or decline has been published by either regulator that I could find. The company targets closing by the end of 1H FY27 (2026-11-30), so the call will have to give a status: remedy, delay, or a closing date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has turned on this deal. Its announcement came with the 2026-04-09 Q3 release, which moved -2.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Antitrust dockets in two small jurisdictions are not on most screens, and the FY27 guide still includes Genomics, so the street models are built on the guide either way. Asked what the money buys: it is deleveraging, not distress. Gross debt is ~$794m and the company says it is fully compliant with covenants. A delay therefore pushes back delevering and does not threaten liquidity, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The ACCC Phase 2 referral is reported by MLex on 2026-07-20 (https://www.mlex.com/mlex/amp/articles/2503077) and Beef Central. The missing decision after 15 Sep is an absence of news, not a document, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: The US New World screwworm outbreak that began 2026-06-03 in Texas reached about 47 confirmed cases by early September, and USDA released its billionth sterile fly around 2026-09-07. Texas began lifting restrictions in some counties. Neogen has two topical aerosols (Prozap) authorised in Texas and Florida, and management guided only a 'modest contribution' in Q1 (June-August). Animal Safety was ~26% of Q4 revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated. Animal Safety supply problems were part of the 2025 misses, and the Q4 FY26 sequential recovery (+7%) was part of the +22.66% print.
findings.why_not_priced: Management guided 'modest', so this lands inside the guide. The outbreak stayed contained, so the upside is small. The only unpriced part is whether 'modest' was conservative, given that cases rose from 20 in late June to ~47.
findings.independence: A proxy, not a company number. The case count of 20 on 2026-06-25 comes from https://www.fox4news.com/news/u-s-new-world-screwworm-cases-rise-20-texas-outbreak-expands. The product authorisations come from the Q4 release.

findings.finding: bioMérieux, the closest listed food-safety testing peer, reported Industrial Applications +7% organic in H1 2026, with double-digit reagent growth and North America up nearly 6% (release 2026-07-28). Its Q2 overlaps one month of Neogen's June-August Q1, and it reported two days before Neogen last spoke.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Neogen's Food Safety core growth reaching 5.8% was the headline of the +22.66% print.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it predates Neogen's own guide. It confirms that end-market demand stayed firm into the start of Neogen's Q1.
findings.independence: A peer proxy. Neogen's CFO separately cited producer commentary that industry volumes turned positive in calendar Q1 2026 (https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_financials/2026/q4/NEOG-USQ_Transcript_4Q26.pdf).

findings.finding: The stock gave back from ~$13.98 (52-week high, after a 31% post-print rally) to $12.22, -4.0% over 5 days and -4.5% on 2026-09-29 alone. MarketBeat found no company headline and attributed it to caution ahead of the release and Investor Day. Short interest rose to 11.17m shares (5.1% of float, 4.5 days to cover) at 2026-09-15, and the 25-delta put skew is +15.3 vol points.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2025 drawdowns the stock rallied on the next three prints (+16.49%, +31.57%, -2.9%, +22.66%). Into this print the position has been de-risked, not crowded.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is mostly priced by definition. The small positive comes from the lower bar: Earnings Whispers framed the bar at $13.76 'creating a high bar', and the stock now sits 11% under that. The positive is sized small because it runs against the skew. Why the options market may be wrong here: the skew may be pricing an investor-day 'invest now' message that the July call already disclosed.

findings.finding: Piper Sandler upgraded NEOG to Overweight with a $14 target on 2026-08-26. The consensus target is $12-13.33 against $12.22 spot.
findings.why_not_priced: It is on the wire and priced. Filed only because it shows sell-side sentiment improving into the event.
findings.independence: Same MarketBeat page as the positioning finding. The target range is also at https://stockscan.io/stocks/NEOG/forecast.

findings.finding: The CEO bought 370 shares at $11.81 on 2026-08-04, held indirectly through his son, worth about $4.4k. The 2026-08-14 Form 4s are annual PSU and option grants to the CEO, CFO and others at a $11.65 strike. The 2026-08-19 Form 4s are tax withholding on vesting. There were no open-market sales.
findings.why_not_priced: Trivial in size. The only content is that there was no insider selling into the 31% rally.

findings.finding: Director Thierry Bernard resigned from the board on 2026-08-03 with no reason given (8-K item 5.02, filed 2026-08-07). It is the only 5.02 since the Q4 print. No CEO, CFO or CAO change was filed before the amc switch, and the 2026-09-28 DEFA14A only corrects an ESPP share count (1m to 6m) for the 2026-10-01 annual meeting.
findings.why_not_priced: A non-executive director leaving is not a print driver. Filed because the sweep asked whether anything changed alongside the release time, and the answer is no officer change.

findings.finding: On the Q4 call the CFO said many food-producer customers 'are still facing inflationary cost pressures as a result of the Iran war' and that management keeps 'a tempered view' on near-term trends, after Q4 also took higher freight and material costs in gross margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 gross margin still expanded 330bp despite these costs, and the stock rose 22.66%.
findings.why_not_priced: Already inside the Q1 guide, which management set with this view, so it is sized near 0.
findings.independence: Same transcript as findings 1 and 2, a different line.

outside_window.finding: The Petrifilm manufacturing transition to Lansing begins in November 2026 and runs for several quarters. Management guided 200-300bp of gross margin expansion, with the benefit mostly in FY28. The first fully validated SKU was due by the end of August 2026 and was not separately announced, so the Q1 release will confirm it or flag a slip (that confirmation is inside the window). The transition itself and its margin benefit come after the window.
The next FINRA short-interest release (settlement 2026-09-30) is due 2026-10-09, after the window.

baseline_tension: The mild long lean runs against the +15.3 put skew and against a stock still up 126% off its low, but with the 12.6% pullback from the high. The case for it is the company's documented habit of beating its own guide by about 5%, and the explicit reason the options market may be wrong is that the investment-heavy message it may be pricing was already given on the July call. The tension pulls p_up to 54 and the positioning finding down to +0.3.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (sign against a strong skew): the positioning finding went from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up from 55 to 54, with an explicit reason given for why the skew may be wrong
Lesson 5 (absence of news is not a cause): the Genomics regulatory finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, because the missing NZ decision is inferred from silence rather than a document
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the divestiture proceeds buy. The answer is deleveraging, with covenants compliant, so the finding stays small and is not read as distress
Lesson 6 (inside the guide): the 'Iran war' cost-pressure finding went from -0.2 to -0.1, because Q1 was guided with that view already in it
Lessons 1 and 8 left the sandbag finding at +1.5: beats on this name have been bought (+16.5, +31.6, +22.7), but Q1 is pre-guided, so it is not sized larger
abs_move_pct went from 12 to 13 for the Investor Day stacked inside the window (core 3b: hunters' numbers run small)
